spec.title: Cluster storage
spec.description: Persistent volumes, NAS and node disks. Pick a namespace to inspect it after an alert.

spec.name: namespace
spec.label: Namespace
spec.description: Narrows volume panels. NAS and node panels always show the whole cluster.

spec.title: Volumes
spec.description: PersistentVolumeClaims in the selected namespaces.

spec.title: Provisioned
spec.description: Sum of the storage requested by the claims.

spec.title: Used
spec.description: Bytes in use on mounted volumes. Unmounted claims report nothing.

spec.title: Fullest volume
spec.description: Highest used/capacity ratio among mounted volumes. See the Volumes tab for which one.

spec.expr: max(max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{job="kubelet", namespace=~"$namespace"}) / max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{job="kubelet", namespace=~"$namespace"}))

spec.title: Full within 14d
spec.description: Volumes whose 7d trend predicts running out of space within two weeks (same rule as PersistentVolumeFillingUpSoon).

spec.expr: count(predict_linear(kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes{job="kubelet", namespace=~"$namespace"}[7d], 14 * 86400) < 0 unless on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) kube_persistentvolumeclaim_access_mode{access_mode="ReadOnlyMany"} == 1 unless on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) kube_persistentvolumeclaim_labels{label_excluded_from_alerts="true"} == 1)

spec.title: Storage alerts firing
spec.description: Firing PersistentVolume alerts in the selected namespaces plus node-disk and NAS alerts.

spec.title: Firing storage alerts
spec.description: Hidden while nothing fires.

spec.title: Fullest volumes
spec.description: Mounted volumes by used/capacity.

spec.expr: topk(12, max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{job="kubelet", namespace=~"$namespace"}) / max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{job="kubelet", namespace=~"$namespace"}))

spec.title: Used by namespace
spec.description: Bytes in use per namespace.

spec.title: NAS iSCSI volume free
spec.description: Free space on the Synology volume holding the thin-provisioned LUNs. Thin LUNs fail writes when it runs out, whatever each PVC reports.

spec.title: Fullest NAS pool
spec.description: Highest usage among the Synology storage pools and volumes.

spec.title: NAS disks unhealthy
spec.description: Disks whose status or health is not Normal.

spec.title: Fullest node disk
spec.description: Highest usage among node root and data filesystems.

spec.title: Released volumes
spec.description: PersistentVolumes left behind by a deleted claim. With the Retain policy their NAS LUN still holds space until removed by hand.

spec.title: Volumes
spec.description: One row per claim. Usage columns stay empty while no pod mounts the volume. Click a namespace to narrow the dashboard to it.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, storageclass) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{namespace=~"$namespace"}) * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left () max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_resource_requests_storage_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace"})

max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{job="kubelet", namespace=~"$namespace"}) / max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{job="kubelet", namespace=~"$namespace"})

max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{job="kubelet", namespace=~"$namespace"}) - (max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{job="kubelet", namespace=~"$namespace"}) offset 1d)

(max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes{job="kubelet", namespace=~"$namespace"}) / -deriv(max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes{job="kubelet", namespace=~"$namespace"})[7d:])) / 86400 > 0 < 365

properties.value: Days until full at the 7d trend. Empty when not filling within a year.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{job="kubelet", namespace=~"$namespace"}) / max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{job="kubelet", namespace=~"$namespace"})

spec.title: Growth per hour
spec.description: Rate of change of used bytes. Positive means filling.

spec.title: IOPS
spec.description: Operations per second per volume, as seen by the NAS. Read plotted below zero, write above. Synology iSCSI volumes only; local-path volumes have no per-volume I/O.

spec.expr: label_replace(label_replace(max by (iSCSILUNInfoIndex) (iSCSILUNIopsRead) * on (iSCSILUNInfoIndex) group_left (iSCSILUNName) max by (iSCSILUNInfoIndex, iSCSILUNName) (iSCSILUNName), "persistentvolume", "$1", "iSCSILUNName", "k8s-csi-(.+)") * on (persistentvolume) group_left (claim_namespace, name) max by (persistentvolume, claim_namespace, name) (kube_persistentvolume_claim_ref{claim_namespace=~"$namespace"}), "persistentvolumeclaim", "$1", "name", "(.+)")

label_replace(label_replace(max by (iSCSILUNInfoIndex) (iSCSILUNIopsWrite) * on (iSCSILUNInfoIndex) group_left (iSCSILUNName) max by (iSCSILUNInfoIndex, iSCSILUNName) (iSCSILUNName), "persistentvolume", "$1", "iSCSILUNName", "k8s-csi-(.+)") * on (persistentvolume) group_left (claim_namespace, name) max by (persistentvolume, claim_namespace, name) (kube_persistentvolume_claim_ref{claim_namespace=~"$namespace"}), "persistentvolumeclaim", "$1", "name", "(.+)")

spec.title: Throughput
spec.description: Bytes per second per volume. Read plotted below zero, write above. Synology iSCSI volumes only; local-path volumes have no per-volume I/O.

spec.expr: label_replace(label_replace(max by (iSCSILUNInfoIndex) (iSCSILUNThroughputReadHigh * 4294967296 + iSCSILUNThroughputReadLow) * on (iSCSILUNInfoIndex) group_left (iSCSILUNName) max by (iSCSILUNInfoIndex, iSCSILUNName) (iSCSILUNName), "persistentvolume", "$1", "iSCSILUNName", "k8s-csi-(.+)") * on (persistentvolume) group_left (claim_namespace, name) max by (persistentvolume, claim_namespace, name) (kube_persistentvolume_claim_ref{claim_namespace=~"$namespace"}), "persistentvolumeclaim", "$1", "name", "(.+)")

label_replace(label_replace(max by (iSCSILUNInfoIndex) (iSCSILUNThroughputWriteHigh * 4294967296 + iSCSILUNThroughputWriteLow) * on (iSCSILUNInfoIndex) group_left (iSCSILUNName) max by (iSCSILUNInfoIndex, iSCSILUNName) (iSCSILUNName), "persistentvolume", "$1", "iSCSILUNName", "k8s-csi-(.+)") * on (persistentvolume) group_left (claim_namespace, name) max by (persistentvolume, claim_namespace, name) (kube_persistentvolume_claim_ref{claim_namespace=~"$namespace"}), "persistentvolumeclaim", "$1", "name", "(.+)")

spec.title: Disk latency
spec.description: Average NAS disk latency per volume. Read plotted below zero, write above. Synology iSCSI volumes only; local-path volumes have no per-volume I/O.

spec.expr: label_replace(label_replace(max by (iSCSILUNInfoIndex) (iSCSILUNDiskLatencyRead) * on (iSCSILUNInfoIndex) group_left (iSCSILUNName) max by (iSCSILUNInfoIndex, iSCSILUNName) (iSCSILUNName), "persistentvolume", "$1", "iSCSILUNName", "k8s-csi-(.+)") * on (persistentvolume) group_left (claim_namespace, name) max by (persistentvolume, claim_namespace, name) (kube_persistentvolume_claim_ref{claim_namespace=~"$namespace"}), "persistentvolumeclaim", "$1", "name", "(.+)")

label_replace(label_replace(max by (iSCSILUNInfoIndex) (iSCSILUNDiskLatencyWrite) * on (iSCSILUNInfoIndex) group_left (iSCSILUNName) max by (iSCSILUNInfoIndex, iSCSILUNName) (iSCSILUNName), "persistentvolume", "$1", "iSCSILUNName", "k8s-csi-(.+)") * on (persistentvolume) group_left (claim_namespace, name) max by (persistentvolume, claim_namespace, name) (kube_persistentvolume_claim_ref{claim_namespace=~"$namespace"}), "persistentvolumeclaim", "$1", "name", "(.+)")

spec.title: Queue depth
spec.description: iSCSI commands waiting in the LUN queue. Sustained non-zero values mean the NAS cannot keep up.

spec.expr: label_replace(label_replace(max by (iSCSILUNInfoIndex) (iSCSILUNQueueDepth) * on (iSCSILUNInfoIndex) group_left (iSCSILUNName) max by (iSCSILUNInfoIndex, iSCSILUNName) (iSCSILUNName), "persistentvolume", "$1", "iSCSILUNName", "k8s-csi-(.+)") * on (persistentvolume) group_left (claim_namespace, name) max by (persistentvolume, claim_namespace, name) (kube_persistentvolume_claim_ref{claim_namespace=~"$namespace"}), "persistentvolumeclaim", "$1", "name", "(.+)")

spec.title: Volumes not Bound
spec.description: Released and Failed PersistentVolumes. With the Retain policy the NAS LUN outlives the claim; delete the LUN on the NAS after checking nothing needs it.

spec.expr: max by (persistentvolume, phase) (kube_persistentvolume_status_phase{phase!="Bound"} == 1) * on (persistentvolume) group_left (claim_namespace, name, storageclass, reclaim_policy) max by (persistentvolume, claim_namespace, name) (kube_persistentvolume_claim_ref) * on (persistentvolume) group_left (storageclass, reclaim_policy) max by (persistentvolume, storageclass, reclaim_policy) (kube_persistentvolume_info)

spec.title: Free space, 30 days
spec.description: A falling line on the iSCSI volume eats into every thin-provisioned PVC.

spec.title: Node filesystems
spec.description: Root and data filesystems of the cluster nodes. local-path volumes live on these.

spec.expr: 1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node-exporter", fstype=~"ext4|btrfs|xfs|zfs", mountpoint!~"/boot.*|/nix/store"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter", fstype=~"ext4|btrfs|xfs|zfs", mountpoint!~"/boot.*|/nix/store"} * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter"})

node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node-exporter", fstype=~"ext4|btrfs|xfs|zfs", mountpoint!~"/boot.*|/nix/store"} * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter"})

spec.title: Read-only node filesystems
spec.description: Node filesystems remounted read-only. iSCSI volumes mounted inside pods are not covered: node-exporter skips kubelet mounts.

spec.title: CSI operation errors
spec.description: Failed CSI calls made by kubelet (attach, mount, stats).
